name: Your project architecture / State the project and its success criteria

intent.outcome: Diagram a project you know deeply. Explain its design choices and the limits you encountered.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Authored worked example for the sourced open-ended project prompt, not a claim about the reader's employment or an actual incident. It models admission, worker service, leased delivery and idempotent result keys. Queue ACK means accepted work, not finished report; no HTTP polling endpoint, real report rendering, durable disk, authentication or operational deployment is implemented.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.
